purpose: 연구 상세 모달 개선 이미지 시안 3개, 게임 미적용

prompts.a:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished high-fidelity image proposal for the Korean RuneNexus mobile game's RESEARCH DETAIL MODAL. Portrait 440x900 logical phone screenshot, no device bezel, no proposal letter/title outside the UI. Reference image1 is existing research detail modal: reuse its dimmed research-list backdrop, cyan flask icon, dark navy matte metal, clipped corners, pale blue beveled outer frame with tiny top-center diamond. Reference image2 is the latest approved account modal: match its restrained navy metal and teal primary button, crisp readable Noto Sans KR-like typography. Only redesign the research modal. Do not make a whole new research page. Single continuous outside frame, subtle thin separators allowed, NO nested framed cards, brown cards, pill tags, giant padding, oversize glowing art, white web/SaaS UI, new game functionality, invented controls or extra labels. Keep the modal vertically centered, about86% of phone width, original background. Main title occurs only ONCE: "연구 효율". Small cyan flask icon and "Lv.0 / 20" serve as identity/subtitle. Quiet "×" at top right. Show full existing explanation plainly, without an inset card: "레벨마다 연구 효율이 5% 증가합니다." and "효율 100%는 이후 연구를 2배 빠르게 만듭니다." Show unlock condition "해금 조건  기본 해금" in quiet secondary text. Must show current effect +0% and next effect +5%, clearly labeled "현재" and "다음", next is warm gold. Must show resource COST50 rune and owned1000 using tiny original gold rune icon; exact text "필요 룬 50", "보유 1,000". Must show exact "연구 시간 30분" with small restrained clock icon. Only one teal metal primary action "연구 시작". No "취소" button; top x closes. No duplicate costs/effects/titles; no changed research rules. Values are illustrative mockup data. Text must be correctly written Korean and all specified information retained. Composition must be feasible for narrow mobile UI.
VARIANT A — COMPACT READING ORDER. Modal about320 logical pixels high. Top single title row with tiny flask left of title, x right; Lv subtitle underneath title. Explanation as two quiet wrapping lines immediately below. Small unlock line. One open horizontal effect line "현재 +0%  →  다음 +5%" at medium size16. Thin separator. Compact open two-column metrics: cost and owned on left, time on right, consistent baselines. Bottom medium height44 full-width teal primary "연구 시작". Reduce visual duplication and height; natural comfortable padding16 and modest gaps. Primary focus remains title, effect and action, not every line bold.
